description:
【48V 15AH Battery】Designed for adult riders, the K10 electric bike is fitted with a 48V 15Ah rechargeable and removable lithium-ion battery. It offers a reliable 36 miles range on a single full charge, and can reach an impressive maximum range of 60 miles when used in pedal assist (PAS) mode. Powerful battery life function can eliminate your travel concerns.Charging the battery from empty to full takes roughly 6 hours.
【1000W Brushless Motor】This AMYET electric bicycle is equipped with a 1000W high-speed brushless motor, delivering a top speed of 28 mph. Boasting a peak output of up to 1500W, the motor generates ample power to effortlessly tackle steep slopes. It's perfect for tackling mountains, snow, beaches, rocky roads and urban areas.
【7-Speed Gears & Digital LCD Display】The K10 electric off-road mountain dirt bike is equipped with a professional 7-speed gear system, ideal for all terrains and speed needs. The intuitive shifter enables smooth gear shifts. Its LCD display provides 5-level speed control and real-time data: battery status, trip/ODO, max/avg speed, PAS mode, and cruise indicator...etc.
【20"x4" Fat Tire & 330 LBS Max Capacity】The AMYET K10 ebike comes with 20×4 inch fat tires, lockable aluminum dual shock absorbers and dual mechanical disc brakes reduce vibration on rough surfaces,ensure superior durability and safety. Its high-carbon steel triangular frame is exceptionally stable and strong. The adjustable seat suits all riders and it supports a maximum payload of 330 lbs, making it ideal for taller or larger riders.
【Simple Assemble & Safe】The AMYET electric bike arrives 90% assembled. So you won't have to waste time with the complicated assembly. It comes with an instruction manual and installation tools. Besides, all AMYET products are ensured with UL 2849 Certified safety certification. Tips: please fill in your recipient's contact number when placing an order to match the policy of large items’ shipment.
